findings.issue: Explanation alternatives depend on candidates metadata
findings.description: The _explain_alternatives_rejected() method needs a 'candidates' key in items_metadata to explain why other items were not selected. Currently this metadata is never populated in the pipeline, so alternatives are always empty. Either pass candidate items from the caller or document this limitation.

Confidence is extracted from LLM explanation text via regex for 'confidence: <number>' or heuristic (parfait → 0.85). If the LLM's format changes, extraction fails silently. Consider requesting structured JSON output from the LLM or logging when extraction fails.

At 5°C with only linen items, the first filter removes all items, then the lenient pass reinclude all of them. While this ensures a result, weather constraints are ignored at boundary temperatures. Consider a continuous weight-based filtering approach.
